{{Top|leg}}
A '''lift-mine''' was a [[Mine/Legends|mine]] with built-in [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] that enabled it to float above the surface of [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Lift-mines could be set to hover at a preset altitude, or vary their height between two preset levels. The more sophisticated lift-mines, like [[Norsam Corp.|Norsam's]] [[DR-X55]] could detect enemy craft at a range of one hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and adjust their altitude to intercept.
